title: Label-only LIST requests can route to search for any kind; field selectors still require manifest
answers: Why does my LIST with a field selector on an external app kind fall back to a full store scan?
Can I list resources from a kind with no compiled manifest using label selectors?
How does the server decide whether to serve a LIST from the search index or the store?
body: shouldUseSearchForList routes a LIST to the search index whenever the request has no field selectors (req.Options.Fields is empty), regardless of whether the resource's group has a manifest compiled into the binary — labels are indexed for every kind. If field selectors are present, the group must still match an AppManifests()-compiled manifest, because selectable fields are mapped into the index from the manifest; a field the index never indexed returns no results. Don't remove the manifest check for the field-selector branch even when simplifying this function.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource — any code deciding search vs. store routing for LIST
